FICTIONAL UNIVERSITY DISCLAIMER: Horizon Delta University (HDU) is fictional. All answers, fees and contact details are invented for software demonstration and testing only.

=== REGISTRATION AND COURSES ===

Q: How do I add or drop a course?
A: Use the student portal during the add/drop period, which is the first two weeks of Fall and Spring. A course dropped in this period does not appear on the transcript. The exact deadlines are in the Academic Calendar of the Student Handbook.

Q: What if I want to leave a course after the add/drop deadline?
A: You can withdraw until the withdrawal deadline (the end of week 10 in Fall and Spring) and receive the grade W. See the Student Handbook for the calendar dates.

Q: Does a W grade lower my GPA?
A: No. A W appears on the transcript but is not used in the GPA. The credit hours of the course do not count as earned.

Q: How many credit hours can I register for?
A: A normal load is 12 to 18 credit hours. Students on academic probation can register for at most 12. Overload rules are in the Student Handbook.

Q: Can I repeat a course I failed?
A: Yes, up to 2 repeats. The highest grade counts in the CGPA, and all attempts stay on the transcript.

Q: Is the Summer semester compulsory?
A: No. Summer is optional, the maximum load is 7 credit hours, and only four courses are offered (CAI-101, MAT-101, GEN-101 and BUS-101).

Q: Can I change my faculty (major)?
A: Yes, after completing at least 24 credit hours with a CGPA of at least 2.5. Apply in the student portal during the add/drop period of Fall or Spring. The tuition rate of the new faculty applies from the semester after the one in which the change is approved. The head of the new department decides which completed courses are transferred.

=== GRADES AND EXAMS ===

Q: What happens if I miss more than 25% of the classes of a course?
A: You receive the grade DN, you cannot sit the final exam, and DN counts as F.

Q: How do I request a make-up exam?
A: Submit a request with documents within 3 working days of the missed exam. The head of the department decides. The make-up exam fee is 300 EGP per exam. The fee is waived when the head of the department approves hospital documentation.

Q: How do I appeal a grade?
A: Send a written appeal to the head of the department within 7 calendar days after grades are published. You receive a decision within 10 working days.

=== DOCUMENTS AND CARDS ===

Q: How do I get a transcript?
A: An unofficial transcript is free in the student portal. An official stamped transcript costs 100 EGP and takes 3 working days. Each extra copy of the same transcript costs 50 EGP.

Q: How much is an enrollment certificate?
A: 50 EGP, ready within 1 working day.

Q: I lost my student ID card. What should I do?
A: Request a replacement at the Registrar's Office. The fee is 200 EGP and it takes 2 working days. Remember that an ID card is required to enter exams.

=== MONEY ===

Q: When is the tuition payment deadline?
A: The deadlines are in the Tuition, Fees and Scholarships document: Thursday 10 September 2026 for Fall 2026 and Thursday 4 February 2027 for Spring 2027.

Q: Do I keep my scholarship if I am on academic probation?
A: Merit-based scholarships (Entry Excellence and Merit) are suspended while you are on probation. The Sibling Discount and the Need-Based Grant continue. See the Tuition, Fees and Scholarships document.

Q: Where can I find the university housing and transport prices?
A: In the Student Services guide, which is written in Arabic.

4.2 How GPA is calculated
GPA is the sum of (grade points multiplied by credit hours) for every course of the semester, divided by the
total credit hours of those courses. CGPA is calculated in the same way using all courses taken at HDU, with
repeated courses counted once using the highest grade.
4.3 Passing grades
The minimum passing grade in any course is D (60 percent). However, every major core course must be
passed with a grade of C (2.0) or higher to count toward graduation; otherwise the student must repeat it.
4.4 Repeating courses
A course may be repeated up to 2 times, so a student has at most 3 attempts. All attempts appear on the
transcript, but only the highest grade counts in the CGPA.
4.5 Incomplete grade
An Incomplete (I) may be granted for a documented reason. The missing work must be finished within 4 weeks
after the semester ends, otherwise the I becomes an F.

5.2 Academic probation
A student whose CGPA is below 2.0 at the end of a Fall or Spring semester is placed on academic probation.
While on probation: (a) the student may register for a maximum of 12 credit hours per semester; (b) the student
must meet the academic advisor at least once per semester; (c) merit-based scholarships are suspended, as
explained in the Tuition and Scholarships document. The student returns to good standing when the CGPA
reaches 2.0, and a suspended scholarship can be reinstated from the following semester.
5.3 Academic dismissal
A student is dismissed if the CGPA is below 2.0 at the end of two consecutive regular semesters (Fall and
Spring; Summer is not counted). A dismissed student may appeal in writing to the Academic Standing
Committee within 10 calendar days of the notification. The committee decides within 10 working days.
5.4 Dean's List
A student is placed on the Dean's List for a semester if the semester GPA is 3.5 or above, the student
completed at least 12 credit hours in that semester, and received no grade below C. The list is announced
within 2 weeks after final grades are published.

A student who is absent from more than 25 percent of the sessions of a course receives the grade DN and
cannot sit the final exam. DN counts as F in the GPA.
6.2 Exam rules
A valid HDU student ID card is required in every exam. A student arriving more than 30 minutes after the exam
starts is not admitted.

# دليل الخدمات الطلابية 2026-2027: جامعة هورايزن دلتا

رقم المستند: HDU-SS-2026-01 | النسخة 1.0 | اللغة: العربية | العملة: الجنيه المصري | الغرض: اختبار نظام RAG

> **تنويه: جامعة وهمية.** جامعة هورايزن دلتا (HDU) جامعة وهمية. جميع الأسعار والمواعيد وبيانات التواصل في هذا المستند مختلقة لأغراض التجربة والاختبار فقط.

## 1. السكن الجامعي

**من يحق له السكن؟** الطلاب القادمون من خارج القاهرة الكبرى (القاهرة والجيزة والقليوبية).

| نوع الغرفة | السعر |
|---|---|
| غرفة مفردة | 18,000 جنيه للفصل الدراسي |
| غرفة مزدوجة | 11,000 جنيه للفرد في الفصل الدراسي |

- **وديعة التأمين:** 3,000 جنيه، تُسترد عند إخلاء السكن بعد التخرج أو ترك الجامعة بشرط عدم وجود تلفيات.

# Horizon Delta University: Tuition, Fees and Scholarships 2026-2027

Document ID: HDU-TS-2026-01 | Version 2.0 | Effective: Fall 2026 | Currency: Egyptian pound (EGP) | Purpose: RAG chatbot testing

> **FICTIONAL UNIVERSITY DISCLAIMER.** Horizon Delta University (HDU) is fictional. All amounts, dates and rules below are invented for software demonstration and testing only.

**This document replaces the 2025-2026 tuition policy (Version 1.0) for all semesters from Fall 2026 onward.** The 2025-2026 policy is archived and must not be used for 2026-2027 questions.

## 1. Tuition per credit hour

Tuition depends on the student's faculty and is charged per registered credit hour.

| Faculty | Tuition per credit hour |
|---|---|
| Computing and AI (CAI) | 4,200 EGP |
| Business (BUS) | 3,600 EGP |
| Engineering (ENG) | 4,800 EGP |

Tuition for a semester = registered credit hours multiplied by the tuition per credit hour of the student's faculty. The number of credit hours of each course is listed in the Course Catalog.

## 2. Fees (not discounted by any scholarship)

Tuition for a semester = registered credit hours multiplied by the tuition per credit hour of the student's faculty. The number of credit hours of each course is listed in the Course Catalog.

## 2. Fees (not discounted by any scholarship)

| Fee | Amount | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Registration fee | 1,500 EGP per Fall or Spring semester | 750 EGP for the Summer semester. Never refunded. |
| Student activities fee | 400 EGP per Fall or Spring semester | Not charged in Summer. Never refunded. |
| Lab fee | 600 EGP per course that has a lab | Courses with a lab are CAI-301 and ENG-102. |
| Late payment fee | 500 EGP | Charged when the payment deadline is missed. |

Housing and transport are not part of tuition or fees; they are described in the Student Services guide.

## 3. Payment deadlines

| Semester | Payment deadline |
|---|---|
| Fall 2026 | Thursday 10 September 2026 |
| Spring 2027 | Thursday 4 February 2027 |
| Summer 2027 | Thursday 24 June 2027 |

## 4. Installment plan

An installment plan is available when the semester tuition is at least 20,000 EGP.

- A 3% administrative charge is added to the tuition.
- The tuition plus the 3% charge is split into two equal installments.
- The first installment, together with **all fees**, is due on the payment deadline.
- The second installment is due at the end of week 6 of the semester (Thursday 29 October 2026 for Fall 2026, Thursday 25 March 2027 for Spring 2027).

## 5. Scholarships and discounts

## 5. Scholarships and discounts

| Scholarship | Discount on tuition | Conditions |
|---|---|---|
| Entry Excellence Scholarship | 50% | Admission score of 95% or above. Applies to the first two semesters. Renewed each year while the CGPA is at least 3.5 and the student is full-time (at least 12 credit hours). |
| Merit Scholarship | 25% | For the next semester when the CGPA is at least 3.7 at the end of the previous semester and at least 12 credit hours were completed in it. |
| Sibling Discount | 10% | For the second and any further sibling who is enrolled at HDU at the same time. |
| Need-Based Grant | 10% to 30% | Apply with family income documents by 15 August (for Fall) or 15 January (for Spring). |

Rules:

1. Discounts apply to **tuition only**, never to fees, housing or transport.
2. The Entry Excellence Scholarship and the Merit Scholarship cannot be combined; the larger one applies.
3. All other discounts can be combined, but the **total discount can never exceed 60% of tuition**.
4. **Academic probation:** merit-based scholarships (Entry Excellence and Merit) are suspended while the student is on academic probation, as defined in the Student Handbook. The Sibling Discount and the Need-Based Grant are not affected. A suspended scholarship can be reinstated from the semester after the student returns to good standing.

### Worked example

### Worked example

A Computing and AI student registers for 12 credit hours with no lab course and holds the Entry Excellence Scholarship. Tuition is 12 x 4,200 = 50,400 EGP. The 50% scholarship reduces it to 25,200 EGP. Fees are 1,500 + 400 = 1,900 EGP. The total to pay is 27,100 EGP.

## 6. Refunds

### 6.1 Complete withdrawal from the university

| When the student withdraws | Tuition refund |
|---|---|
| Before the semester starts | 100% |
| Weeks 1 and 2 | 80% |
| Weeks 3 and 4 | 50% |
| Week 5 or later | 0% |

Fees are never refunded. Approved refunds are paid by bank transfer within 15 working days.

### 6.2 Dropping a single course

If a student drops one course during the add/drop period, the tuition of that course is removed in full (credit hours of the course multiplied by the tuition per credit hour). After the add/drop deadline there is no tuition refund for a single course; a withdrawal (W) gives no refund.
